values.PipelineName: ET North Side to Paris Loop

researcher_notes: Found only in the EIA natural gas pipeline projects workbook, dated August 2026, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 516. EIA lists it as a completed new intrastate pipeline in Texas by Energy Transfer Co, in service August 2008, 145 miles, 30 and 36 inch, 350 MMcf/d, reported June 2009 (also in every earlier release). No existing roster row matches it. Nearest are P0180 East Texas Gas Pipeline and P0264 Texas Intrastate System, which are whole systems with unknown ends. The EIA cost is not stated. Start and end points are not stated beyond the name; the Paris end is presumably Paris, Texas. The search for a second independent source (Texas Railroad Commission filing, Energy Transfer release) was not completed because the search tool hit a session limit. Owner spelled to match the gazetteer entry Energy Transfer LP; EIA wording is Energy Transfer Co. Interstate silence at FERC is expected because the line is intrastate. Route not researched; RouteType left blank. One source only, so medium confidence and independent is false.
